# Gacha Simulator

> Free, open-source web tool for simulating gacha / loot-box pull rates. Add items with
> custom relative drop rates, roll manually or auto-roll until a target drops, and see
> per-item chance percentages live. Works entirely in the browser — no account, no server,
> nothing is saved.

The tool is bilingual (English / Indonesian, toggle in the navbar). UI copy for both
languages lives in the `T` dictionary inside `index.html`.

## Key features

- **Custom item pool**: add items one by one or bulk-insert `name,rate` pairs (comma or newline separated). Rates are relative — each item's chance = its rate / total of all rates.
- **Manual roll** and **auto roll**: auto-roll repeats until the chosen target item drops, with a configurable safety limit (max rolls).
- **Refine mode**: items carry an effect (+1 up, -1 down, 0 stays) applied to a position counter — useful for simulating enhancement/upgrade systems.
- **Live stats**: per-item chance percentages, rolls this session, roll history.
- **Privacy by design**: no localStorage, no IndexedDB, no backend. Closing or refreshing the tab resets everything.

## Technical notes

- Single static page: one `index.html` with inline CSS and vanilla JavaScript (no framework, no build step).
- Hosted as a static site; source: https://github.com/IndyJones123/gacha-simulator
- The QRIS donate image (`alfiandevqris.jpeg`) is the only other asset besides generated SEO images (`og.png`, `favicon.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-512.png`).
